info.description: Afinis is a diverse group of organizations working to support advancement and use of API standardization in the financial services industry. Utilization of this API requires a developer to [register](https://www.afinis.org/user/register) their application.
info.title: Pay Me API

post.summary: Enable a biller to route billing information electronically to any customer through any network.

requestedExecutionDate.description: Date at which the initiating party requests the clearing agent to process the payment

creditor.title: Creditor
creditor.description: Party to which an amount of money is due.

name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

debtor.title: Debtor
debtor.description: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

schemeName.description:
Name of the identification scheme:
   * `CUST` - CustomerIdentificationNumber, Number assigned by an issuer to identify a customer
   * `TXID` - TaxIdentificationNumber, Number assigned by a tax authority to identify a person
   * `Other` - Other Identifier
   * `Biller Access Code` - Biller Access Cod
   * `TrucTXID` - Truncated TaxIdentificationNumber
   * `Other Secondary` - Secondary Other Identifier

birthDate.description: Date on which a person is born

debtorAccount.title: Debtor Account
debtorAccount.description: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.

identification.description: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

proxy.description: Specifies an alternate assumed name for the identification of the account.

type.description:
Identification used to indicate the account identification:
 * `EMAL` - Email - Receiver's Email
 * `MBNO` - Mobile Number - Receiver's Phone Number

identification.description: Identification used to indicate the account identification under another specified name.

debtorAgent.title: Debtor Agent
debtorAgent.description: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor

clearingSystemIdentification.description:
Specification of a pre-agreed offering between clearing agents or the channel through which the payment instruction is processed:  
 * `USABA` - Routing Transit number assigned by the ABA for US financial Institutions.

memberIdentification.description: Identification of a member of a clearing system  e.g., a U.S. transit routing number or Canadian Payments Association Routing Number.

minimumAmount.title: Minimum Amount
minimumAmount.description: Minimum amount of payment accepted by supplier for the payment type selected

instructedAmount.title: Instructed Amount
instructedAmount.description: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party

paymentIdentification.title: Payment Identification
paymentIdentification.description: Unique identifier generated by the biller, which can be used for reconciliation purpose and to link a payment to the original bill.

endToEndIdentification.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unambiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain.

locationAndContact.title: LocationAndContact
locationAndContact.description: Location and contact information of the merchant (business) performing the transaction

remittanceInformation.title: RemittanceInformation
remittanceInformation.description: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system

unstructured.description: Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system, in an unstructured form

postalAddress.description: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

streetName.description: Name of a street or throughfare

postCode.description: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail

townName.description: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government

countrySubDivision.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county

phoneNumber.description: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.

channelType.description:
Name of the identification scheme:
   * `EXT` - Phone Number Extension

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `2000` - Invalid JSON structure.
  * `2001` - '[Field name] is missing or invalid.'
  * `2002` - Invalid date.
  * `2003` - Invalid combination of fields submitted. Check the API specification for eligible combinations. 
  * `2004` - '[Field name] cannot be more than [max number] characters.'

message.description: A human readable description of the problem

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `1000` - API key is missing, invalid or expired. 
  * `1001` - API token is invalid, expired, or account associated with key does not have access to that API.

message.description: A human readable description of the problem
message.example: API key is missing, invalid or expired.

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `404` - Resource was not found.

message.description: A human readable description of the problem

errorCode.description:
A programmatic error code:
  * `3001` - Internal Server error.
